name: Brian Orland
story: At GeoComputation '97 and SIRC '97 in Dunedin, Alan Thorn, Terry Daniel and Brian Orland described using GIS data to visualise New Zealand plantation-forest management scenarios. ARC/INFO supplied geographic and terrain information, while SmartForest II, image-processing tools and powerful workstations helped produce photorealistic scenes that could be assessed by managers and the public.
